purpose: Measure purpose-dependent future-response ambiguity of response-blind P1 storage representations and decide whether any representation is worth carrying into LARE/coarse-Richards dynamics experiments.

prior_exposure.firewall: Pilot magnitudes may not set P2 representation selection, horizons, metric weights, deadbands, numerical tolerances, or acceptance thresholds.

formal_predecessor.requirement: P2 execution is blocked until the formal P1 result and its frozen pair manifests exist.

representation_selection_rule.D_AGGRESSIVE: one dimension below the smallest P1 selected dimension with zero collisions at the 1x diagnostic scale; minimum dimension is 2
representation_selection_rule.D_STATE_SEPARATING: smallest P1 selected dimension with zero collisions at the 1x diagnostic scale
representation_selection_rule.D_ROBUST_PLATEAU: smallest P1 selected dimension attaining the global minimum P1 collision count at the widest 4x diagnostic scale
representation_selection_rule.deduplication: If rules select the same end-index partition more than once, execute it once and retain all role labels.

GW_D.name: dynamic shallow-groundwater hydraulic response
GW_D.interpretation: No single scalar score. Flux direction and reversal sequence are reported separately from magnitude errors.

GW_R.name: regional groundwater exchange at approximately daily coupling scale
GW_R.interpretation: Sub-hourly reversal timing is diagnostic unless the declared downstream coupling or decision consumes it.

future_probes.pair_source: exact eight frozen adversarial pairs from formal P1 for each selected representation/control; no pair reselection

structural_hard_gates: mass residual within the existing 1e-12 cm research Reference gate for every accepted branch step
exact reconstruction identity of every frozen P1 start state

relative_state_information_gate.label: PROMISING_RELATIVE_TO_CONVENTIONAL_STATE_COARSENING
relative_state_information_gate.rule: A selected nonuniform representation is promising for further reduced-dynamics work only if its purpose-vector ambiguity is Pareto non-inferior to the preregistered uniform controls at comparable or larger state dimension and is strictly better in at least one primary purpose component.
relative_state_information_gate.note: This is a research-progression gate, not application acceptance.

application_acceptance.rule: Absolute ACCEPT_FOR_PURPOSE requires external application authority. P2 reports the critical application tolerances required by each representation instead of fitting tolerances to the observed errors.
GW_R_critical_quantities: critical allowable one-day recharge/exchange ambiguity in mm
local storage-equivalent head ambiguity E_Q/Sy reported as a function of declared specific yield Sy; diagnostic only, not a substitute for a coupled groundwater response calculation
GW_D_critical_quantities: whether any nonzero flux-sign disagreement occurs outside an externally declared near-zero deadband
application_acceptance.accepted_only_if: A later declared application parameter set or downstream coupled-response authority lies outside all critical-error requirements.

literature_basis.Clark_et_al_2021: Performance metrics must be interpreted with sampling uncertainty and in the context of the model's specific purpose; purpose-specific benchmarks are preferable to arbitrary universal thresholds.
literature_basis.benchmarking_principle: Use explicit lower/reference comparators rather than a free-standing efficiency threshold.
literature_basis.role: Conceptual evaluation authority only; literature does not supply a universal SWAP-ROM tolerance.

pre_execution_comparator_clarification.reason: Make the response-blind relative state-information gate operational without advantaging higher-dimensional uniform controls.
pre_execution_comparator_clarification.primary_uniform_comparator_rule: For each selected nonuniform candidate, use the smallest-dimensional preregistered uniform control whose state dimension is greater than or equal to the candidate dimension.
pre_execution_comparator_clarification.secondary_uniform_controls: All larger preregistered uniform controls are reported as stricter diagnostics but do not replace the primary matched/next-higher comparator.
pre_execution_comparator_clarification.scientific_effect: None on candidate selection, frozen pair selection, probes or thresholds; no formal P2 future response has been executed.

formal_p1_authority_binding.reconciliation: formal selected partitions and all collision-count vectors match the independent exact KD-tree implementation
formal_p1_authority_binding.scientific_effect: Provenance binding only. Candidate rules, probes, horizons, metrics and acceptance semantics are unchanged.
